translations.web: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
translations.bsb: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?
translations.kjv: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
translations.asv: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?
